_comment: Questions shared by every family plan. system_questions runs once at the top of the wizard; control_questions is the per-control template applied to each applicable control. Field types are interpreted by templates/plans/wizard.html.twig and the plans.js client-side state. show_when expressions are evaluated by the wizard JS to drive conditional rendering.

system_questions.label: System name
system_questions.help: Full official name of the information system.

system_questions.label: System acronym / short name
system_questions.help: Short identifier used in headings and references.

system_questions.label: System owner
system_questions.help: Role or named individual accountable for the system.

system_questions.label: System boundary description
system_questions.help: Describe what falls inside the authorization boundary - components, services, networks, data flows.

control_questions.label: Implementation narrative
control_questions.help: Describe how this control is satisfied - tools, processes, frequencies, responsible parties.

control_questions.label: Inheritance provider
control_questions.help: Common control provider this control is inherited from (e.g., 'Enterprise IAM Service').

control_questions.label: Inheritance details
control_questions.help: Reference the provider's authorization, MOU, or boundary documentation.

control_questions.label: Not Applicable rationale
control_questions.help: Justify why this control does not apply.

control_questions.label: Responsible role
control_questions.help: Role accountable for this control's implementation and maintenance.

control_questions.label: Evidence / artifacts
control_questions.help: Supporting documents, configurations, scan reports, screenshots.
